content:
Apple officially announced the date of its major September launch event, with the theme slogan "Surprise and shine", an adaptation of the phrase "rise and shine". Apple is expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone at the event.

Meanwhile, in the localised slogan for China, at least according to Google Translate's translation, there appears to be a hidden easter egg with a similar meaning to "foldable".

Before the official announcement of the "Surprise and shine" slogan, Apple fans looking forward to the first iPhone with a foldable screen had speculated about various event slogans, including playful creations built around the concept of "a lot to unfold".

In China, Google Translate at least translates the English to an almost identical meaning.

If you take a screenshot of the event image from Apple's China website and process it with Google Translate's image translation feature, you get this machine translation result: "A new chapter unfolds, dazzling and brilliant."

Results from other translation tools vary, but with the countdown to this major launch just two weeks away, this is at least an interesting little easter egg for everyone to savour.
